info.title: Railway GraphQL
info.description: Railway GraphQL API using an OAuth bearer token. Users select accessible projects or workspaces during consent. Arbitrary GraphQL bodies can contain mutations; the operation always requires approval.

post.description: Execute a Railway GraphQL query or mutation. Viewer scopes permit reads; member scopes permit changes within the user's role. This operation can mutate infrastructure and always requires approval. Example project discovery query: query { externalWorkspaces { id name projects { id name } } }.
